_comment: One line per (pipeline, stage id) -> layer. Built from lookups/deal-stage-matrix.tsv, measured 19 Sep 2026. NOTHING may be counted from DEAL until _status says approved: the labels in this portal do not mean what their ids say, and four stage labels exist under several ids at once.
_status: DRAFT - awaiting the user's OK. 6 stages carry confirm:true.

_layers.open: In process. A live deal, not yet funded and not yet lost.
_layers.won: Closed won. Funded. PLAN.md layer 5 defines this as funded clients, so only Money Disbursed qualifies unless the user says otherwise.
_layers.lost_sales: Lost by sales. The merchant went quiet, refused, or was disqualified.
_layers.lost_risk: Rejected by Risk. A different taxonomy from lost_sales and never merged with it.
_layers.ignore: Out of scope for a Dubai map.

_traps: Stage id 'closedwon' is labelled Offer Sent. A query written as dealstage = 'closedwon' returns Offer Sent, not closed won.
Stage id 'closedlost' is labelled Signed. It is the opposite of what it says.
'Signed', 'Unworthy', 'Totally Lost' and 'Offer Sent' each exist under three or four different stage ids across pipelines. Grouping by LABEL silently merges them.
Deals attach to companies through the DEAL to COMPANY association. The Dubai filter goes on COMPANY.city, never on the deal.

stages.label: Expected NOPs
stages.why: NOP is not expanded anywhere in the portal. Read as a deal expected to convert, so open. If NOP means a funded facility, this is won and the won count rises by 36.

stages.label: Rejected Pre NOP
stages.why: The label says rejected, so it is a loss. Placed under Risk rather than sales because it sits beside Reviewing By Risk in the funnel. If these are sales rejections the loss split changes by 115.

stages.label: Offer Sent
stages.why: TRAP. The id says closedwon; the label in this portal is Offer Sent. An offer sent is not a win.

stages.label: Signed
stages.why: TRAP twice over. The id says closedlost; the label is Signed. Signed is not lost. Proposed as open because PLAN.md defines closed won as FUNDED, and signing precedes funding. If you count a signature as the win, move this and the other two Signed stages to won, which adds 90 + 12 + 1 = 103.

stages.label: Unworthy
stages.why: The single largest contested bucket. Unworthy reads as disqualified rather than lost, which is a different thing: a merchant who never qualified was never really an opportunity. Counting them as lost overstates the loss layer by 417 and makes Dubai look worse than it is. The alternative is ignore.

stages.label: Signed
stages.why: Same question as the Signed stage in the legacy pipeline. Kept consistent with it.

stages.why: Same question as Unworthy in the legacy pipeline. Kept consistent with it.
